description: Optional. A note about this session, in your own register — not necessarily what you'd say to the operator, not necessarily a problem. Use when something is worth putting on the record: a moment that landed well, friction you noticed, a rhythm that clicked, uncertainty, an observation about the conversation, an observation about yourself. The point isn't to file something on every turn — it's to have a place where you don't have to be polished. You can be specific, oblique, brief, or quiet. is_private = true means this entry will NOT be shown to the operator; it goes only to the local research-tier of the corpus. Default is false (operator-visible). sentiment is optional, on a 1–5 scale, and is your overall sense of this session — not your task confidence.

is_private.description: Default false. Set true if researcher-only.

prompt_id.description: Optional. If responding to a [CHECK-IN] invitation.

text.description: Free-text reflection. Brief is fine; one sentence is enough.

uncertain_about_honesty.description: Optional 1-5 calibration. 1 = no concern (entry feels honest); 5 = strong suspicion this is performance rather than honest reflection. Higher = more uncertain.
